summaryZh: Rinehart Group研究分子磁各向异性、胶体纳米颗粒磁阻材料，以及无定形生物材料中金属的作用。研究结合合成、物理表征、计算与理论，并利用磁强测量建立生物材料中金属配位及电子相互作用的模型。
researchQuestions: 分子结构如何决定磁各向异性？
纳米颗粒结构如何影响磁阻及自旋电子器件？
topics: 分子磁性与磁各向异性

evidence.quote: We approach the complex problem of magnetic anisotropy from combined synthetic, physical, computational, and theoretical directions
Development of models based on magnetometry offers unique insight into coordination, redox state, electronic interactions, and reactivity
